startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: GoFractional job list / category / role pages, e.g. https://www.gofractional.com/jobs/fractional-cmo

maxItems.title: Max jobs
maxItems.description: Stop after this many job records across all start URLs. 0 = no limit.

scrapeDetails.title: Open each job detail page
scrapeDetails.description: Visit every individual job page to add the full job description, company description, the original job-posting URL (apply link) and its source platform. Off = fast list-only pull (still includes rates, hours, company, skills, dates, summary).

followPagination.title: Follow pagination
followPagination.description: When a list page reports more results, keep fetching ?page=2, 3, … until exhausted or Max jobs is hit.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only new jobs since last run
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: Remember every job seen in past runs (in a persistent store) and output only jobs not seen before. Turn this ON for a daily/scheduled run so you get just the new postings, not the same list every day.

maxAgeDays.title: Max age (days)
maxAgeDays.description: Skip jobs published more than this many days ago. 0 = no age limit (GoFractional itself only lists the last ~30 days).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: gofractional.com is behind Cloudflare. Apify residential or unblocker proxy is strongly recommended.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel browser pages. Keep low to avoid Cloudflare rate limiting.

debug.title: Debug mode
debug.description: Also push the raw Next.js pageProps payload for any page where no jobs were parsed. Useful for diagnosing selector drift.

dumpOnly.title: Dump only (diagnostic)
dumpOnly.description: Do not scrape. Just fetch each start URL and push its raw Next.js pageProps + a shape outline. For debugging the parser.
